entities.summary: Charles VIII, a notable figure in the history of Italy, associated with The Italian Renaissance (1494–1559). Preceded by Italian Wars and Foreign Domination and Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis. Their legacy influenced Leonardo da Vinci paints The Last Supper and Michelangelo completes the Sistine Chapel ceiling.
